# GLM 5.3 sparse attention: retrieval and stale-index controls

Pinned GLM5.3 FP8/BF16 official manifests: 755.632 GB/1506.667 GB; custom GLM5.3 license. Five seeds, 2880 synthetic sparse query evaluations; k32 projected recall .971875 vs unrelated stale .00625, relative MSE .032824 vs 1.247011. Stale control is not actual cross-layer IndexShare. No native inference, learned indexer, speed claim or Manager promotion. H15/H17 delegated #745.

[Code and evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/tree/chatgpt/glm-h16-20261127/files/research-artifacts/glm-h16-2026-11-27)

Sources: [Ampersand](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/blog/model-card.html), [GLM5.3](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3), [GLM5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2), [GLM-5 technical report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15763).
